summary.one_liner: A step-by-step book/guide that teaches building blockchains from scratch in Ruby, starting with crypto hashes.
summary.what_it_does: The README is a short table of contents for a book/guide titled Programming Blockchains Step-by-Step. It lists chapters covering crypto hashes, blocks and blocks with proof-of-work, blockchains and how a blockchain can be detected as broken, timestamping, mining, and Bitcoin. The guide is described as building blockchains from zero, starting with crypto hashes. A "To be continued" marker and a references/links section are also listed. The README does not show any code, install steps, or runnable project; the content itself is only available via the linked live version.
use_cases: learn how blockchains work by building one
understand crypto hashes in a blockchain
read a public domain blockchain tutorial in Ruby
notable: Builds a blockchain from zero, starting with crypto hashes
Covers proof-of-work, blockchain tamper detection, timestamping, mining, and Bitcoin
Dedicated to the public domain with no restrictions
Part of the openblockchains project, with links to more blockchain books
caveats: The guide is marked 'To be continued', so coverage is incomplete
The README contains no code or setup instructions; the content lives at an external live site
README alone gives only a chapter outline, not the full material
